functions.name: Auto Tool Selector
functions.purpose: Offline-safe inlet filter that enables relevant local OpenWebUI tools and configured MCP tool servers for the current message.

functions.name: Context Compressor Filter
functions.purpose: Counts chat-context tokens before model calls, normalizes zero output-token requests and keeps oversized prompts inside a safe context budget.

functions.name: Markdown Normalizer
functions.purpose: A content normalizer filter that fixes common Markdown formatting issues in LLM outputs, such as broken code blocks, LaTeX formulas, and list formatting. Including LaTeX command protection.

functions.name: Workbench Required File Context Filter
functions.purpose: Injects Workbench model required files as protected full-context system block and attaches their OpenWebUI file IDs to every request.
